core_principles: Function over form: color is used strictly to convey status (success, error, loading).
Control Room Layout: High density, rigid grids, 1px borders to separate data.
Developer familiarity: Use mono-spaced fonts for technical data, logs, and variables.

mono.usage: Build logs, environment variables, commit hashes, domain names

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

navigation.style: Top-bar navigation, border-b border-slate-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-50

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md shadow-sm font-medium px-4 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2

terminal_logs.container: bg-slate-950 rounded-md border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden font-mono mt-4
terminal_logs.text: text-slate-300 text-[13px] leading-relaxed p-4 h-[400px] sm:h-[500px] overflow-y-auto

status_badge.style: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border capitalize

forms.input: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-slate-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
forms.label: text-sm font-medium leading-none peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-70

icons.size: w-4 h-4 for inline, w-5 h-5 for structural layout

motion.loading: animate-pulse for skeletons, animate-spin for active deployment indicator icons

Abstract visual for empty states (no deployments yet)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Work Sans (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), and JetBrains Mono (Logs/Code) fonts.
Use Shadcn UI extensively: tabs, cards, dropdowns, forms, dialogs, badges.
Follow Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast): Keep the UI highly functional and grayscale heavy. Color should only be used to indicate status (Emerald for success, Red for failure, Blue for building).
Implement the layout relying on borders and slight grays to separate content. Avoid heavy card shadows, use border separation (1px solid).
The build logs view must simulate a terminal: use dark slate background (bg-slate-950) with JetBrains Mono font, ensuring new logs auto-scroll.
Ensure responsive design: Stack project lists and deployment detail views correctly on mobile viewport.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute for testing.
